headline: Viral audio: Former OC Rakibul Islam's voice confirmed by DB
summary: Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police has confirmed that a viral audio clip mentioning Sheikh Hasina's return is the voice of the former Cantonment Police Station OC.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has confirmed that the voice in a viral audio clip is that of former Cantonment Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Rakibul Islam.
Additional Commissioner (DB) Md. Shafiqul Islam announced this during a briefing at the DMP Media Center on Minto Road, Dhaka, on Wednesday.
The identification was made through a voice test conducted with the permission of the court.
Police officials stated that they are currently investigating the overall circumstances behind the audio, including who the former OC spoke with and the reasons for his comments.
The audio clip in question contains comments regarding the possibility of Sheikh Hasina's return to the country in December.
caption:
A viral audio clip mentioning Sheikh Hasina's return has been confirmed as the voice of a former police officer.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has confirmed that the voice in a viral audio clip is that of former Cantonment Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Rakibul Islam.

Additional Commissioner (DB) Md. Shafiqul Islam announced this during a briefing at the DMP Media Center on Minto Road, Dhaka, on Wednesday.

The identification was made through a voice test conducted with the permission of the court.

Police officials stated that they are currently investigating the overall circumstances behind the audio, including who the former OC spoke with and the reasons for his comments.

The audio clip in question contains comments regarding the possibility of Sheikh Hasina's return to the country in December.

headline_marked: MP Gazi Nazrul's [[bail plea rejected]] in second wife's death case
headline: MP Gazi Nazrul's bail plea rejected in second wife's death case
summary: A Dhaka court has denied bail to the Satkhira-4 MP in a case involving the abetment of suicide of his second wife, Mariyam Islam.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has denied bail to Gazi Nazrul Islam, the Member of Parliament for Satkhira-4, in a case regarding the abetment of suicide of his second wife, Mariyam Islam.
Metropolitan Magistrate Md. Ariful Islam issued the order on Wednesday, noting that the victim was very young and had committed suicide while in the custody of the elderly defendant.
The court further stated that granting bail to the defendant at this stage could lead to adverse reactions in society.
The incident occurred on September 20, when police recovered the hanging body of Mariyam Islam from a flat in the NAM building opposite the Parliament building.
Following the recovery, police took Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda, into custody that same night.
The case was filed by the victim's father, S M Masum Billah, who accused Gazi Nazrul, his first wife Maksuda, and the victim's uncle, Obaidur Rahman, of abetting suicide.
While Maksuda has since been granted bail, Gazi Nazrul Islam and Obaidur Rahman remain in jail.
caption:
A Dhaka court has denied bail to MP Gazi Nazrul Islam in a case involving the abetment of suicide of his second wife.

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate's court has denied bail to Gazi Nazrul Islam, the Member of Parliament for Satkhira-4, in a case regarding the abetment of suicide of his second wife, Mariyam Islam.

Metropolitan Magistrate Md. Ariful Islam issued the order on Wednesday, noting that the victim was very young and had committed suicide while in the custody of the elderly defendant.

The court further stated that granting bail to the defendant at this stage could lead to adverse reactions in society.

The incident occurred on September 20, when police recovered the hanging body of Mariyam Islam from a flat in the NAM building opposite the Parliament building.

Following the recovery, police took Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife, Maksuda, into custody that same night.

The case was filed by the victim's father, S M Masum Billah, who accused Gazi Nazrul, his first wife Maksuda, and the victim's uncle, Obaidur Rahman, of abetting suicide.

While Maksuda has since been granted bail, Gazi Nazrul Islam and Obaidur Rahman remain in jail.
